name: diversity_probe_v1
description: Diversity probe for cross-work similarity evaluation. Uses synthetic audio spanning different musical organizations. These are evaluation diversity probes, not product genre classes.
selection_rule: Deterministic synthetic audio generation with fixed seeds. Each probe represents a materially different musical organization: sparse/acoustic-like, dense/produced-like, rhythm-forward, groove-heavy, jazz/improprovisatory, expressive/classical, and culturally distinct patterns.
license: Generated synthetic audio - no copyright restrictions

probes.description: Sparse acoustic-like: simple melody with minimal harmonics
Dense produced-like: rich harmonics with layered frequencies
Rhythm-forward: percussive envelope with strong transients
Groove-heavy: syncopated pattern with bass emphasis
Jazz/improvisatory-like: complex harmonic series with vibrato
Expressive/classical: smooth legato with dynamic envelope
Culturally distinct: non-Western scale-like pattern with microtonal hints

windowing.description: Fixed 10s windows with 5s hop for within-work segment similarity
